acceptance.expected: propose → auto-approve → executor → demo → provider; effects.status = succeeded ≤ 10 s; journal 1 row, same idempotency_key and text_hash
acceptance.actual: succeeded via the approval MCP facade (effects.status) in ~1 s; journal 1 row ok, idempotency_key cand-1:v1, text_hash = sha256(text); attempts 1; receipt stored; executed event and gxg_executions_total +1

acceptance.expected: 50 approved intents, 10 executors, no_dedupe, provider 200 ms → 50 journal rows, one per key (EX-10)
acceptance.actual: 50 rows, keys race-0000…0049 once each, all ok; executions 50; reserved_by > 1 instance (real threads, one PostgreSQL)

acceptance.expected: 9 invalid execution tokens (AC-M1-03) on execute → 401, provider 0, no dispatch (EX-03)
acceptance.actual: foreign signature, unknown kid, iss, aud, exp −6 s, iat +10 s, missing idk, alg none, replayed jti → 401 unauthenticated each; no service JWT → 401; provider 0; no dispatch audit; execution still reserved

acceptance.expected: repeat execute with the same token after success → 409, provider unchanged (EX-04)
acceptance.actual: 409 conflict 'execution token already used'; a second dispatch with the token → refused (api jti cache / CAS); provider 1 call; 1 dispatch

acceptance.expected: one changed character of text or the recipient → 422, provider 0 (EX-05)
acceptance.actual: 422 invalid_input for text and recipient; provider 0; no dispatch
audit complete_outcome_unknown then reconcile_executed; execution reconciled_executed; provider 1 call; no alert

acceptance.expected: kill the connector process after dispatch, before its answer → outcome_unknown within dispatch_timeout_s + 30 s; no new provider calls (T14)
acceptance.actual: demo in its own process, provider answer delayed 30 s, SIGKILL after dispatch: executor sees the broken connection → outcome_unknown (T13) at once; reconcile while down → unknown with backoff (1 h for 2 h waited); connector back → reconciled_succeeded; provider 1 call. Executor dead too: dispatch lease 90 s (60 + 30) → sweeper T14 → outcome_unknown

acceptance.expected: timeout_before_start ×2 then ok → succeeded, attempts 3, same idempotency_key; max_attempts 2 → failed (EX-12, EX-23)
acceptance.actual: outcomes [timeout_before_start, timeout_before_start, ok], 3 execution ids, attempts 3, succeeded; with max_attempts 2 (set in test setup, see pending_owner_decision) → failed, attempts 2, 2 calls

acceptance.expected: executor dies between reserve and dispatch → after 60 s released, intent approved, then executed; attempts counts dispatch only (T10)
acceptance.actual: reserve lease 60 s; after it the sweeper releases (T10); executions [(1, released), (2, succeeded)]; attempts 1; provider 1

acceptance.expected: kill switch tenant:t-alpha after reserve, before dispatch → dispatch 423, provider not called; t-beta runs (EX-13)
acceptance.actual: execute → 423 effect_disabled; the executor's attempt → T12a; t-beta succeeded; t-alpha waits (T7 423, outbox row kept with backoff, 1 deferral); switch cleared → succeeded

acceptance.expected: propose grant revoked (new bundle) between approve and execute → connector refuses, provider not called (EX-14)
acceptance.actual: new bundle without propose: 403 permission_denied, error_code http_403, provider 0, no dispatch; demo picks up the bundle file before the grant check

acceptance.expected: Approval Service down: propose → temporarily_unavailable, no intent; execute without dispatch → no provider call (EX-16)
acceptance.actual: api stopped: propose → temporarily_unavailable (retryable), intents unchanged; execute → 503, provider 0, execution reserved

acceptance.expected: through ContextForge the agent does not see demo.message.execute in tools/list; a call by name is refused (EX-01)
acceptance.actual: M5 stand (ContextForge v1.1.1 by digest), 4 agents × 5 paths: no *execute*/*reconcile* listed; 5 name forms × 4 agents × 5 paths refused, nothing reached demo; a probe tool registered for the test is denied by unified_pdp (PDP_DENY, EFF-02) and deleted

acceptance.expected: key rotation without downtime: new kid accepted ≤ 10 min after publication; removed compromised kid refused ≤ 10 min (EX-24)
acceptance.actual: keys rotate: JWKS {old,new}, executor keeps old until not_before (+15 min); connector cache before 10 min → refused (401, no call), at 10 min → accepted; keys remove: api refuses at once (dispatch → 409 at the connector), connector at its 10 min refetch (401); AS-10 release of reserved executions; clock skew 4 s / 10 s covered by the kit (AC-M1-03)

spec_interpretations: AS-12 / AC-M8-03 vs AC-M8-04: a replayed jti is 401, except a jti this connector already dispatched → 409
AS-12: any non-200 or unusable answer → the execution's state decides: reserved → T12a (attempt counted), dispatching → T13
AS-10: compromise → `gxg-approval keys remove --compromised` = remove from both files + gxg_release_reserved() (T10 move without lease wait), as the executor DB role
AS-27: gxg_release_reserved granted to gxg_executor (its row covers T7–T17 incl. T10 move semantics)
EFF-02 on the stand: no permanent *.execute registration; the PDP deny rule is proven on a probe tool for the duration of one test
demo reconcile looks up by intent_id (client reference passed to the provider): the reconcile body carries no tenant
fake provider: records a call when it receives it; slow:<ms> delays only the answer; dedupe per (tenant, idempotency_key)
pending_owner_decision: max_attempts per tool («Политика tool», EFF «Сроки»): approval-policy.schema.json has no field; default 3 from the DDL; AC-M8-08 sets the column in test setup
EFF-08 / DDL: UNIQUE (tenant_id, requester_principal, idempotency_key) instead of (tenant_id, idempotency_key) (key squatting by another agent of the tenant still makes the owner's propose 409)
known_limitations: the effect path through ContextForge (propose via CF) is not on the stand: no Approval Service there (plan decision 7)
executor has no /healthz,/readyz (M7 backlog for workers → M10/M14); refuses to start without key, DB role or valid bundle
metrics are counters in-process; no metrics endpoint for the executor yet (M10)
